M1 Writes $\sec^23x$ as $\sec3x\times\sec3x$ and uses the product rule with $u'=A\sec3x\tan3x$ and $v'=B\sec3x\tan3x$ to produce a derivative of the form $A\sec3x\tan3x\sec3x+B\sec3x\tan3x\sec3x$. dM1 Replaces $\sec^23x$ with $1+\tan^23x$ to produce an expression in just $\tan3x$.
